caption: The drawing depicts a large, lidded metal pitcher or coffee pot positioned in the center of the composition, viewed from the side. The object has a metallic appearance, rendered in grayscale shades, with detailed shading that gives the surface a reflective, slightly shiny quality. The pitcher has a wide, rounded base that tapers slightly inward as it rises, then flares out to form the shoulder and neck of the vessel. The lid is dome-shaped with a small round knob at the top. On the left side, there is a curving spout that extends outward and up from the body, while on the right side is an ornate, thick handle with a pronounced scroll design near the top and bottom. At the bottom left of the drawing, there is a horizontal scale labeled "scale" with hash marks, and in the bottom right corner is the handwritten name "Grace Halpin." The background is a plain, light beige color with a slight gradient, and there are no other objects or elements in the drawing.
title: Pewter Coffee Pot
